n20198e7397.headline: Putin sends Russia FM, Kremlin adviser to meet Trump officials in Riyadh Tuesday
n20198e7397.summary: The Kremlin said Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov and foreign policy adviser Yuri Ushakov were flying to Riyadh on Tuesday at Putin's request to meet Trump administration officials.
n20198e7397.why: Russia-US contacts over Ukraine and sanctions shape energy supply expectations and geopolitical risk premia. Saudi Arabia is a major oil producer and frequent host of such talks.

n93963d3529.headline: Loans down 1% in Jan amid growth slowdown says ABI - Business - Ansa.it
n93963d3529.summary: Italian banking association ABI said in its monthly report that the recent slowdown in Italy's economic growth is helping to depress demand for loans. Loans to businesses and households fell 1% in January from a year earlier.
n93963d3529.why: Bank lending is a key indicator of credit demand and economic momentum. The ABI is the Italian banking association that publishes monthly lending data for the country's banks.

n1ffd43232e.headline: CREDITCORP gives Nigerians N20bn to buy Innoson, other locally-made vehicles
n1ffd43232e.summary: The Consumer Credit Corporation (CREDITCORP) announced the first beneficiaries of the N20 billion automotive loan scheme. The scheme aims to help the local auto industry buy locally made vehicles, including Innoson.
n1ffd43232e.why: Auto loan schemes support local manufacturing and consumer credit in Nigeria. Innoson is a Nigerian vehicle maker, and the scheme targets domestic auto sales.

n65feb05322.headline: Indian markets on February 17: Nifty 50 and Sensex extend losses - Invezz
n65feb05322.summary: Indian benchmark indexes the Nifty 50 and Sensex extended their losses on February 17. No further details were provided in the report.
n65feb05322.why: The Nifty 50 and Sensex are the main benchmark equity indexes of India's National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange.

n39141350f3.headline: Portugal's Galp expects tougher year ahead after profit drop
n39141350f3.summary: Portugal's Galp Energia expects a tougher year after reduced oil output and falling crude prices led to a lower-than-expected fourth-quarter core profit. The company's co-CEO commented on the outlook.
n39141350f3.why: Galp is a Portuguese integrated energy company with oil exploration, refining and gas activities, so its results track crude prices and output.

ndd6199d7d9.headline: Brazil Faces Fiscal Challenges as Debt Rises Despite Spending Cuts
ndd6199d7d9.summary: Brazil's government spending decreased in 2024, yet public accounts stayed in deficit and gross debt climbed. Analysts remain concerned about the fiscal outlook.
ndd6199d7d9.why: Brazil's fiscal position affects its sovereign debt ratings, interest rates and the real currency, which matter for local and global investors.

nd15b5cb945.headline: Taxes, housing top reasons for outmigration
nd15b5cb945.summary: A survey of former Massachusetts residents by a pro-business group found that taxes and the high cost of housing were among the top reasons they left the state.
nd15b5cb945.why: Migration patterns affect state tax revenues, labour supply and local housing demand, which matter for regional economic forecasts.

ndd3f17c95c.headline: Oil theft drops to 5,000bpd - NUPRC
ndd3f17c95c.summary: The NUPRC said oil theft in Nigeria has dropped to 5,000 barrels per day. Oil production now averages 1.75 million barrels per day, with gas output at 7 billion cubic feet daily.
ndd3f17c95c.why: Nigeria is one of Africa's largest oil producers, and production volumes and losses to theft directly affect government revenue and export supply.

nd1024739ad.headline: Azevedo & Travassos Energia Surges 118% on B3 Debut, Targets Oil Sector Growth
nd1024739ad.summary: Azevedo & Travassos Energia (AZTE3) made its debut on the São Paulo Stock Exchange on February 14 and surged 118%. The company targets growth in the oil sector.
nd1024739ad.why: B3 is Brazil's main stock exchange, and new listings from energy companies reflect investor appetite for Brazil's oil and gas sector.

ndd815201b5.headline: Cross-Border Payments, A.I. and Climate Action: Key Agendas for BRICS Summit in Rio
ndd815201b5.summary: Brazil will host the BRICS leaders' summit on July 6-7, 2025, in Rio de Janeiro. Key agenda items include cross-border payments, artificial intelligence and climate action.
ndd815201b5.why: BRICS is a bloc of major emerging economies, and its decisions on payments and trade can influence capital flows and global economic arrangements.

nae9e5430d5.headline: Sensex, Nifty eke out gains in volatile session, end eight-day losing run - OrissaPOST
nae9e5430d5.summary: The benchmark Sensex closed 57.65 points higher at 75,996.86 after snapping an eight-day losing run. Gains were driven by value buying in HDFC Bank and Reliance Industries.
nae9e5430d5.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking 30 large Indian companies, and it reflects sentiment in India's equity market.

neaad09b912.summary: Ghana's LMI has secured funding for an industrial solar plant, according to the report. The input provides no further financial details.
neaad09b912.why: Industrial solar projects add power capacity and reduce energy costs for manufacturers, which matters for energy and capital allocation in emerging markets.

ne12e88fdc3.summary: London stocks were slightly firmer in early trade on Monday. Defence firms BAE Systems and Rolls-Royce powered ahead on expectations of higher defence spending.
ne12e88fdc3.why: The FTSE 100 is the UK's main blue-chip index. BAE Systems and Rolls-Royce are large constituents whose order books depend heavily on government defence budgets.

n6698435467.headline: Illegal connections, municipal debt deepen Eskom’s crisis in Free State
n6698435467.summary: Electricity Minister Kgosientsho Ramakgopa outlined the severity of Eskom's crisis in the Free State, citing illegal connections and municipal debt, and government intervention plans.
n6698435467.why: Eskom is South Africa's state power utility, and supply losses and unpaid municipal bills affect the country's electricity supply and fiscal risk.

n9780868d86.headline: BNR revises inflation forecast upwards; general downward trend maintained throughout the year
n9780868d86.summary: The National Bank of Romania revised its inflation forecast upwards while maintaining a general downward trend through the year. Governor Isarescu linked higher rates to internal political tensions and warned a trade war could cause recession.
n9780868d86.why: The National Bank of Romania sets monetary policy for the leu, and its inflation outlook guides interest rate and currency decisions.

n3784b0aeac.headline: Zelensky travels to United Arab Emirates as momentum grows for war peace talks
n3784b0aeac.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky arrived in Abu Dhabi after attending the Munich Security Conference in Germany. The trip comes as momentum builds for peace talks to end the war.
n3784b0aeac.why: Progress toward a Ukraine peace settlement affects energy, grain and sanctions expectations, and European and emerging-market risk sentiment.

nc62fa67c90.headline: Bill introduced to again try for progressive income tax in Illinois
nc62fa67c90.summary: A new bill filed in the Illinois General Assembly would allow income to be taxed at varying rates, replacing the current single flat rate required by the state constitution. It would make raising rates easier for lawmakers.
nc62fa67c90.why: Changes to state income tax rules affect personal and business tax liabilities and the state's fiscal outlook and bond credit profile.

n7637861059.headline: FG appeals for dignified process as U.S. clears 85 Nigerians for deportation
n7637861059.summary: Godrej Properties bought 12 land parcels during April to December of the current fiscal year to develop housing projects worth Rs 23,450 crore. It plans more purchases this quarter.
n7637861059.why: Godrej Properties is a Mumbai-based listed real estate developer, and its land bank determines future residential sales and revenue visibility.

n6219362ccf.headline: Gigantic losses reported by Northvolt in last month of 2024
n6219362ccf.summary: Swedish battery maker Northvolt reported huge losses in just over a month, according to Sveriges Radio Ekot, with the losses largely attributed to very large items. The report covers the last month of 2024.
n6219362ccf.why: Northvolt is a Swedish battery manufacturer that supplies the electric vehicle industry, so its finances bear on European battery supply and EV-related investment.

n9064459b96.headline: Expelling Nicaragua from the CAFTA would cause trade tension in the region and more migration
n9064459b96.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has threatened to formally expel Nicaragua from the Central American Free Trade Agreement with the United States. Critics warn of trade tensions and more migration in the region.
n9064459b96.why: CAFTA-DR is the trade agreement linking the United States with Central American economies, so expulsion of a member would disrupt tariff-free trade and regional supply chains.

nb068169569.headline: Tariffs are beginning to make an impact on housing construction costs
nb068169569.summary: Tariffs are beginning to affect housing construction costs, and with more tariffs planned, builders and developers are worried about higher home prices.
nb068169569.why: Homebuilders and developers depend on imported materials, so tariffs on building inputs feed into construction costs and housing affordability.

n5a04aeb898.headline: Almost 300 pubs close, with 4,500 jobs lost, as calls made for Government action
n5a04aeb898.summary: 289 pubs served last orders for the final time in 2024, costing 4,500 jobs, according to fresh figures from the British Beer and Pub Association, which called for government action.
n5a04aeb898.why: Pubs are a core part of the UK hospitality sector, and closures reflect pressures on consumer spending, costs and employment in that industry.

n73dec9af94.headline: Market snaps 8-day losing streak as pharma, metal stocks lead recovery
n73dec9af94.summary: The Sensex closed 57 points higher, ending an eight-day losing streak. Gains were led by value buying in blue-chip stocks, with pharma and metal shares leading.
n73dec9af94.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking 30 large listed Indian companies.

n10d9b3a386.headline: European defence stocks surge as region's leaders plan spending boost
n10d9b3a386.summary: European defence shares rallied as leaders prepared an emergency meeting on regional security and a planned increase in defence spending.
n10d9b3a386.why: Defence stocks respond to government budgets for military spending, which directly drive order books for European defence contractors.
n10d9b3a386.why_moved: Investors reacted to European leaders' plans to boost spending amid an emergency meeting on regional security.

n8d8662ca6b.headline: China's Xi holds rare meet with business leaders amid US tech rivalry
n8d8662ca6b.summary: President Xi Jinping held a rare, highly choreographed meeting with some of China's biggest technology executives amid rivalry with the United States.
n8d8662ca6b.why: China's leading technology companies are central to global supply chains and face US export and competition restrictions that affect their valuations.

n700a7eca48.headline: Aviva's India Arm Hit With $7.5 Million Fine for Fake Invoice Scheme, Order Shows
n700a7eca48.summary: Indian authorities ordered the local unit of British insurer Aviva to pay $7.5 million in back taxes and penalties. An investigation found the unit created fake invoices.
n700a7eca48.why: Aviva is a UK-listed insurer with operations across Europe and Asia, and tax disputes in key markets can affect its costs and reported earnings.

n0beee3f22f.headline: Sysmex Corporation reports sustained 9M performance
n0beee3f22f.summary: Sysmex reported results for the nine months to December, released February 12, 2025. Net sales rose 12.4% year on year to JPY366.9bn, with sales and profits at record highs.
n0beee3f22f.why: Sysmex is a Japanese maker of clinical diagnostic and blood-testing equipment with a global customer base in hospitals and laboratories.

n29b937484b.headline: Sensex  rises! These  stocks rallied over 15% on BSE in today
n29b937484b.summary: Several stocks rallied more than 15% on the BSE in a session when 35 Nifty50 stocks closed higher and 15 ended lower. The Sensex index advanced during the session.
n29b937484b.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large Indian companies and is the main benchmark for domestic equity sentiment.

nc74f7fe7ee.headline: Dutton prays for rate cut as RBA enters conclave
nc74f7fe7ee.summary: Dutton called for a rate cut as the Reserve Bank board entered its meeting, though economists say a major reduction in mortgage rates this year is unlikely.
nc74f7fe7ee.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia's cash rate decisions set the benchmark for mortgage and business lending rates across the country.

nde275f9f6c.headline: Trump energy secretary says net zero emissions by 2050 is 'sinister' goal
nde275f9f6c.summary: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright on Monday criticised efforts to reach net zero carbon emissions by 2050, calling the goal 'sinister'.
nde275f9f6c.why: Net zero targets shape long-term capital allocation in power, oil and gas, and clean energy, so shifts in US federal energy policy affect investment decisions.

n8d42cc4ade.headline: China's Xi meets with business leaders, including Alibaba cofounder Jack Ma, to boost economy
n8d42cc4ade.summary: Chinese leader Xi met business leaders including Jack Ma, CATL chairman Zeng Yuqun, BYD chairman Wang Chuanfu and Tencent CEO Pony Ma at a Beijing meeting on Monday.
n8d42cc4ade.why: CATL and BYD are major battery and electric vehicle makers, and Tencent operates the WeChat platform, so government engagement with them signals policy toward China's large private firms.

nbd83d5807f.headline: German cities struggle with budget amid rising costs, weak economy, survey shows
nbd83d5807f.summary: Most German cities are unable to present balanced budgets this year, a survey showed, amid poor growth and high social spending. The findings came days before an election.
nbd83d5807f.why: Municipal finances reflect local government spending and revenue, and weak budgets can affect public investment and infrastructure across Germany's economy.

n632b7b1a07.headline: PM Shehbaz optimistic about further inflation decline in coming days
n632b7b1a07.summary: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said inflation is now in single digits and that he is optimistic it will decline further in coming days. He also said efforts to improve the economy are underway.
n632b7b1a07.why: Inflation levels guide central bank policy and the cost of borrowing, which matter for Pakistan's bond market and currency.

n3733e20ebb.headline: Rupee slides 16 paise to close at 86.87 against US dollar
n3733e20ebb.summary: The Indian rupee depreciated against the US dollar, closing at 86.87, amid foreign fund outflows, dollar-buying and global uncertainty. The fall was 16 paise.
n3733e20ebb.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects import costs, inflation and returns for foreign investors holding Indian equities and bonds.

n7347751aab.headline: How Trump's environment-related executive orders may affect climate, energy
n7347751aab.summary: President Trump signed a number of executive orders pushing back on environmental goals in the same week wildfires ravaged Los Angeles. The orders could affect climate and energy policy.
n7347751aab.why: Federal environmental and energy rules affect the cost and regulatory outlook for oil, gas, renewables and utilities in the United States.

na88852b8fc.headline: HFCL sets ₹10,000-cr revenue target, eyes growth from overseas sales
na88852b8fc.summary: HFCL aims to reach ₹10,000 crore in revenue through overseas sales, defence supplies and expansion into Europe.
na88852b8fc.why: HFCL is an Indian telecom equipment maker, and its growth plans reflect demand for telecom gear and defence supplies.

nd7df1f5618.headline: Cutting funding for science can impact economy, U.S. technological competitiveness
nd7df1f5618.summary: Analysis warns that America has already lost its global competitive edge in science. Funding cuts proposed in early 2025 could accelerate that decline, with possible economic effects.
nd7df1f5618.why: Public research funding feeds innovation, productivity and the pipeline of technology companies, so changes to it matter for long-run economic growth.

nd405fb122a.headline: Defence stocks boost European markets amid emergency talks over Ukraine war
nd405fb122a.summary: BAE Systems shares jumped about 9% on Monday, lifting European markets as emergency talks over the Ukraine war were held. The defence maker produces weapons, military vehicles and aircraft.
nd405fb122a.why: BAE Systems is a major British defence contractor, and its shares tend to react to shifts in military spending and geopolitical tensions.

n9af45bc082.headline: Looser state aid rules aim to stoke clean tech demand
n9af45bc082.summary: A European Commission draft sets out ways for governments to subsidize and boost clean-tech investments under looser state aid rules.
n9af45bc082.why: State aid rules determine how far EU governments can subsidize industry, which affects investment in clean-technology manufacturers.

n7130e618a1.headline: Koreans cut back on coffee in economic slump
n7130e618a1.summary: South Koreans have been spending less in cafes as an overall economic downturn hits discretionary spending. A report by the Korea Rating and Data was cited.
n7130e618a1.why: Discretionary consumer spending is a key gauge of household health and domestic demand in South Korea's economy.

n6246b43140.headline: Japan’s economy grows 2.8% in Q4 as strong domestic demand fuels recovery - Invezz
n6246b43140.summary: Japan's economy grew 2.8% in the fourth quarter, driven by strong domestic demand that is fuelling the recovery.
n6246b43140.why: Japan is the world's fourth-largest economy, and its growth data shapes Bank of Japan policy expectations and the yen.

n5e65c728ba.headline: Forex earnings policy on lines of Malaysia, Vietnam: Hartarto
n5e65c728ba.summary: Indonesia's Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs, Airlangga Hartarto, said a policy on foreign exchange earnings from natural resource exports is being considered on the lines of Malaysia and Vietnam.
n5e65c728ba.why: Rules on export proceeds affect how much foreign currency resource exporters must convert and keep, which influences the rupiah and foreign reserves.

n1df355f59a.headline: Canada is on the front lines of an airship boom — but hurdles still abound
n1df355f59a.summary: Flying Whales Quebec CEO Arnaud Thioulouse is pursuing airships to ferry goods to remote locations. The article says the sector still faces significant hurdles.
n1df355f59a.why: Airships are a niche freight technology that could serve remote areas without roads or rail. Commercial viability depends on regulatory approval and capital for new aircraft programs.

nb6988913d8.headline: City Council to decide on tax package for Commerce Drive housing project
nb6988913d8.summary: The Watertown City Council will decide on a tax abatement package for a developer building affordable housing on Commerce Drive.
nb6988913d8.why: Tax incentives can promote housing development, affecting local real estate markets and construction activity.

nd016e0019f.headline: Australian Listed Real Estate Tables - 17-02-2025
nd016e0019f.summary: FNArena provided current pricing, yield, and valuation data for Australian listed real estate investment trusts and property developers as of February 17, 2025.
nd016e0019f.why: Real estate investment trusts are key income assets for investors; regular data updates support market transparency and investment decisions.

n3a27c4132c.headline: NZ Steel believes demand has reached its floor
n3a27c4132c.summary: NZ Steel reported sharply lower earnings due to low domestic demand, soft global steel prices, and volatile power costs, signaling a demand floor.
n3a27c4132c.why: NZ Steel is a key steel producer in New Zealand; its performance reflects industrial demand and commodity price trends affecting related sectors and investors.

nf2ae78802d.headline: FG plans N2.3tn electricity subsidy in 2025
nf2ae78802d.summary: The Nigerian Federal Government may spend N2.36 trillion on electricity subsidies for low-income consumers in 2025 amid plans to implement reforms.
nf2ae78802d.why: Electricity subsidies impact Nigeria’s fiscal budget and energy sector reforms, affecting economic growth and public finances.

nedd7c5cdd2.headline: Ringgit opens higher against US$ on stronger GDP growth in 4Q24
nedd7c5cdd2.summary: The Malaysian ringgit opened higher against the US dollar and ASEAN currencies following stronger GDP growth in Malaysia's fourth quarter of 2024.
nedd7c5cdd2.why: GDP growth signals economic strength, supporting currency appreciation and improving investor sentiment.
nedd7c5cdd2.why_moved: Better-than-expected GDP growth improved economic outlook, strengthening the ringgit against the US dollar.
